title: Candidate Suite Single-Viewport Golden 10/10 Master Layout Refactor & Zero-Gap Functional Verification
spec: MANDATE: User explicitly requests: 'Refactor layouts of all pages, unlock them and make 10/10 updates. I need SWOT 10/10 rated and extremely high and smooth User experience and Best 10/10 layout for each page. Check the functionality after update and prove that nothing fails and everything is working 100% with no gaps. single Viewport layout is preferable to give best user experience.' (Bridge unlocked for 60 min). PHASE 1 - SINGLE-VIEWPORT OVERVIEW MASTER REFACTOR: In CubaCandidateShell.jsx, DashboardHomepage.jsx, and CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx, re-engineer the Overview layout geometry so the Hero banner, 4 Stat Cards, AI Career Briefing, and Executive Right Rail ALL fit simultaneously within a SINGLE VIEWPORT (1080p/1440p) with ZERO vertical page scrollbar. Compact padding (py-3/p-3.5), tight gaps (gap-2.5/gap-3), and cohesive briefing placement. PHASE 2 - SINGLE-VIEWPORT PARADIGM ACROSS ALL 15 PAGES: Enforce the single-viewport architecture across all Candidate Suite pages (Resumes, Cover Letters split-view, Portfolios Bento grid, Job Tracker intra-column Kanban, Applications, Interview Coach, Messages, Plans, Settings, Support). Every page body must lock within h-[calc(100vh-var(--cuba-header-h))] with internal scrolling where applicable and zero document-level page overflow. PHASE 3 - SWOT 10/10 NATIVE TOKENS & SMOOTH UX: Strict Cuba M3 glassmorphism in both light and dark modes, fluid transitions, and zero layout shift. PHASE 4 - ZERO-GAP FUNCTIONAL VERIFICATION: Author tests/dir084-single-viewport-mastery.test.mjs (AC1-AC8) proving 100% functional integrity, test all interactive controls, maintain build under 4s and lint clean, then submit evidence.

plan.summary: DIR-084 PHASES 1-3 forensics complete; this is the plan. ROOT CAUSE FOUND (PHASE 2 blocker): CubaAppShell.jsx:306 renders the shell root as w-full flex min-h-screen flex-col - min-h-screen, NOT a bounded height. The content row (CubaAppShell.jsx:522 w-full flex min-h-0 flex-1) and <main> (CubaAppShell.jsx:638 w-full min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-x-hidden) therefore never own the vertical scroll, so EVERY candidate page grows the DOCUMENT and the browser window scrollbar appears. That single line is why the whole suite violates the single-viewport paradigm. BLAST RADIUS: CubaAppShell is imported by CubaCandidateShell.jsx:7, CubaPortalShell.jsx:10 (employer/admin/enterprise) and DesignSystemShowcase.jsx:3, so a naive root change would alter four portals. The mandate is the Candidate Suite, so the plan adds an OPT-IN iewportLock prop that only CubaCandidateShell sets - the other portals keep today's behaviour byte for byte, which is both safer and exactly the requested scope. PHASE 1 OVERVIEW GEOMETRY (measured): the Overview stacks, in order, a breadcrumb row (mb-2.5, CubaAppShell.jsx:649), the content pad (pt-2.5 pb-24 md:pt-3 md:pb-6, :644), CubaCandidateHero (banner p-6 sm:p-8 at CubaCandidateHero.jsx:111, h1 	ext-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl at :159, action row mt-6 at :168, ATS gauge panel p-4 at :194, and the FOUR stat cards at :253 in a gap-4 sm:gap-5 grid), AiCareerBriefing (about 90-120px), then the DashboardHomepage Document Gallery plus its four onboarding steps, all inside a space-y-4 md:space-y-5 wrapper (CubaCandidateShell.jsx:456) and a grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,7fr)_minmax(0,3fr)] (CubaCandidateShell.jsx:467) whose main column is space-y-6 and whose rail (CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx:99) is space-y-4. At 1080p that stack is roughly 900-1300px tall against a ~937px viewport, so the Hero, the 4 Stat Cards, the Briefing and the Rail can never be visible together - exactly the user complaint. The fix is to lock the region AND compact it: wrapper space-y-2.5, grid gap-3 promoted to 2xl, main column space-y-3, hero banner p-4 sm:p-5, h1 	ext-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl, action row mt-4, gauge p-3, stat grid gap-2.5 sm:gap-3, rail space-y-2.5 with internal scrolling, and the Document Gallery plus Onboarding moved into an internally-scrolling lower region so they never push the fold. PHASE 3 TOKENS AND SMOOTHNESS: the touched surfaces stay on Cuba tokens with dark: counterparts wherever a raw utility must remain, scroll owners gain scrollbar-gutter: stable so the appearance of a scrollbar cannot shift the layout, and the interactive controls keep their transitions. INVARIANTS: XAMPP-only servers, no detached node/vite/nodemon daemon; frozen src/cv-templates diff 0; no auth, token, API, DB or RBAC change; zero fabricated data - no metric, count or telemetry value is invented and the existing real bindings (count, bestScore, applications, trackedJobs, onboarding progress) are preserved; preserve every DIR-048/055/072-083 pin and the dir081/dir082/dir083 suites; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors. UX STATES: every page keeps the DIR-081 four-state contract and every split view keeps its below-lg single-pane fallback; the locked region must still render loading, empty and error states in full. RESPONSIVE: 375px keeps the single column with the mobile tab bar and its pb-24 reserve; 768px two columns; 1080p and 1440p are the single-viewport targets; 1680px+ keeps the wide cap. QA: tests/dir084-single-viewport-mastery.test.mjs with AC1 the viewportLock contract (root h-[100dvh] min-h-0 overflow-hidden, main min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto, aside h-full) and the opt-in default, AC2 the compacted Overview geometry, AC3 the Hero, the four stat cards, the Briefing and the Rail all inside ONE bounded region, AC4 no document-level min-h-screen remains on any of the 15 candidate page roots, AC5 dark-mode parity on every touched file, AC6 the interactive-control inventory is preserved, AC7 no new dependency and the build stays under 4s, AC8 no layout-shift hazard (scrollbar-gutter stable on the scroll owners). A11Y: the locked region keeps one main landmark and its skip target (cuba-main-content), the scroll owner stays keyboard reachable, focus is not trapped by the lock, aria-current and the labelled regions from DIR-083 are preserved, and contrast stays AA in both themes. PERFORMANCE: the change is layout-only - no new dependency, no timer, no simulated latency - and it should REDUCE paint cost because a bounded scroll region avoids whole-document reflow on every interaction. SEQUENCING AND RISK: the shell prop first (one file, opt-in), then the Overview compaction, then the per-page verification, then the token and smoothness pass. ROLLBACK: reverting the single opt-in prop restores today's document-scroll behaviour for the candidate suite, and each compaction is independently revertible; no schema, API or data surface is touched.
steps: S1 - Add an opt-in viewportLock prop to CubaAppShell so ONLY the candidate suite locks to the viewport: the root becomes h-[100dvh] min-h-0 overflow-hidden, the content row becomes min-h-0 overflow-hidden, main becomes min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto cuba-scrollbar, the aside h-screen becomes h-full, and the mobile pb-24 reserve for the tab bar is kept
CubaCandidateShell passes viewportLock and the employer, admin and enterprise portals are untouched.

S2 - Compact the Overview geometry in CubaCandidateShell: the wrapper space-y-4 md:space-y-5 becomes space-y-2.5, the two-column grid gap-6 becomes gap-3 and moves its split to 2xl, the main column space-y-6 becomes space-y-3, and the aside gains min-h-0 so the rail scrolls internally.

S5 - Move the DashboardHomepage Document Gallery and the four onboarding steps into an internally-scrolling lower region so they never push the Overview fold, keeping their real data bindings and interactions intact.

S6 - Enforce the locked paradigm across the remaining pages: Messages, Cover Letters, Job Tracker, Portfolios and Applied already own bounded regions from DIR-083, so verify them and replace any remaining min-h-screen page root with the locked height so every page body sits inside h-[calc(100vh-var(--cuba-header-h))].

S7 - Token and smoothness pass: replace any remaining raw colour utility with Cuba tokens, add dark: counterparts where a raw utility must stay, add scrollbar-gutter stable to the scroll owners to prevent layout shift, and keep the transitions on the interactive controls.
S8 - Author tests/dir084-single-viewport-mastery.test.mjs (AC1-AC8 as described) and register test:dir084 in package.json.

S9 - Run dir084, dir083..dir072, cuba-candidate-portal, cuba-design-system, the dir048 suites, test:product, test:security:static, test:xampp-policy, dir063..dir084, build (under 4s), lint (0 errors), confirm frozen cv-templates diff 0, write .bridge/evidence/dir084-evidence.log and submit.

evidence.summary: DIR-084 complete. ROOT CAUSE found in recon: CubaAppShell.jsx rendered the shell root as w-full flex min-h-screen flex-col - min-h-screen, NOT a bounded height - so the content row and main never owned the vertical scroll and EVERY candidate page grew the DOCUMENT, producing the browser window scrollbar. S1: because CubaAppShell is shared by the candidate shell, CubaPortalShell (employer/admin/enterprise) and DesignSystemShowcase, the fix is an OPT-IN viewportLock prop that only CubaCandidateShell sets. Under the lock the root becomes h-[100dvh] min-h-0 overflow-hidden, the content row becomes min-h-0 overflow-hidden, the sidebar rail becomes h-full, and main gains data-viewport-lock plus min-h-0 overflow-y-auto cuba-scrollbar [scrollbar-gutter:stable] so main owns the ONLY scrollbar and its appearance can never shift layout; the content cap compacted to min-h-0 px-4 pt-2 pb-24 sm:px-6 md:pt-2.5 md:pb-4 lg:px-8 and the breadcrumb to mb-2. The default is false, so the other portals keep today's behaviour byte for byte and the suite asserts they do not opt in. S2-S4 SINGLE-VIEWPORT OVERVIEW: the wrapper is space-y-2.5 on the Overview; the grid is grid min-h-0 grid-cols-1 gap-3 2xl:h-[calc(100dvh-var(--cuba-header-h)-3.75rem)] 2xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,7fr)_minmax(0,3fr)] so on 1080p (1920px) and 1440p (2560px), both wider than the 1536px 2xl breakpoint, the entire Overview is bounded to exactly one viewport; the main column is a flex column whose fold-critical blocks are flex-none and whose children region is min-h-0 flex-1 2xl:overflow-y-auto with a stable gutter, and the rail is 2xl:overflow-y-auto with a stable gutter. Hero compacted: banner p-6 sm:p-8 to p-4 sm:p-5, h1 text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl to text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl, action row mt-6 to mt-4, ATS gauge p-4 to p-3, and the four-card KPI grid gap-4 sm:gap-5 to gap-2.5 sm:gap-3. CandidateExecutiveRail space-y-4 to space-y-2.5 and AiCareerBriefing space-y-3 to space-y-2. Result: the Hero, the four Stat Cards, the AI Briefing and the Executive Rail are all visible together with zero document scrollbar. S5: DashboardHomepage's Overview branch compacted to space-y-3 and the Document Gallery plus the four onboarding steps moved into the internally-scrolling children region so they never push the fold. S6: six document-level min-h-screen page roots removed - DashboardPortfolios, DashboardInterviews, DashboardSettings and DashboardSupport now use min-h-0 with Cuba canvas/ink tokens, MainJobListings scopes min-h-screen to the public marketing route only, and DashboardHomepage keeps it only in the legacy non-Cuba branch. S8: new tests/dir084-single-viewport-mastery.test.mjs with 8 acceptance tests (AC1 the opt-in lock contract and the proof the other portals do not opt in, AC2 the compacted Overview geometry, AC3 Hero plus four Stat Cards plus Briefing plus Rail inside ONE bounded region, AC4 no document-level min-h-screen page root, AC5 Cuba tokens and no legacy palette on the touched roots, AC6 the interactive-control inventory preserved, AC7 the import allowlist plus a timer ratchet proving no dependency or timer was added, AC8 the stable scrollbar gutter on every scroll owner) and test:dir084 registered; four superseded pins updated in lockstep (DIR-048/077/078 content-cap and breadcrumb, the DIR-078 wrapper assertion and the unlayered-css-guard shell-root assertion). VERIFIED: dir084 8 passing, 149 passing across dir084 + dir083 + dir082 + dir081 + dir080 + dir079 + dir078 + dir077 + dir048 suites + dir055 + cuba-candidate-portal + cuba-design-system + copilot-command-surface, test:dir072..dir084 and test:design-system every script EXIT 0, test:product EXIT 0, security:static 67 passing, xampp-policy 4 passing, build EXIT 0 in 3.41s measured with no concurrent load against a 4.0s budget, lint 0 errors, frozen cv-templates diff 0. MEASUREMENT NOTE: two earlier build readings of 4.71s and 4.99s were taken while the full product and security suites were running in parallel on the same machine; isolated the build is 3.41s. HONEST LIMITS: the lock is opt-in so the employer/admin/enterprise portals were not migrated and that is not claimed; the Overview single-viewport guarantee is scoped to the 2xl breakpoint which covers both mandated targets, while 1280-1535px keeps natural flow; and the wider DIR-082 legacy backlog is unchanged and still ratcheted (DashboardSettings 1330, DashboardInterviews 764, DashboardHomepage 226, DashboardSupport 183, ResumesList 12) - DIR-084 fixed those pages' ROOT palettes but did not sweep their bodies. ZERO FABRICATION: no metric or telemetry value was invented; the Overview renders the same real bindings and only geometry, padding, gap and typography classes changed.
